description: Replicates a Flow recipe as a self-executing object: Space (host) → Inset by `offset` m → Optimise Rectangle (fit `rectCount` rectangles) → Massing (`floorCount` floors). The `pipeline` runs the SAME flow op adapters (evalInset / evalOptimise) over the host polygon, so it renders identically to the source flow with zero per-object code. Attach to a SPACE; the footprint is the space's own polygon. `offset`, `rectCount`, `floorCount` are the flow's input-props; `floorHeight` sets the per-floor stack height (the flow used the app's global floor height).
